spend.body:
[spend_policy]
version = 3
# Waits
max_live_wait = "5m"
max_tool_sleep = "60s"
wait_rules_off = []
wait_rule_patterns = { W1 = [], W2 = [], W3 = [], W4 = [] }
# Limits
soft_quantile = "p85"
hard_multiplier = 2.0
low_confidence_outcomes = 6
low_confidence_soft_share = 0.5
no_history_limit = { small = 10.0, medium = 25.0, large = 60.0 }
review_share = 0.5
review_soft_share = 0.5
plan_hard_multiplier = 2.0
project_daily_limit = 30.0
project_weekly_limit = 50.0
project_warn_share = 0.8
assistant_daily_warn = 0.0
consultation_limit = 2.0
budget_flag_headroom_share = 0.1
# No progress
repeat_limit = 3
repeat_denials_to_park = 2
no_progress_share = 0.5
no_progress_park_multiplier = 2.0
no_history_no_progress = 5.0
# Waiting alert
waiting_alert_share = 0.4
waiting_alert_window = "30m"
waiting_alert_min_calls = 5
# Session classes
assistant_class = "standard"

notify.body:
[notify_policy]
version = 3
desktop = true
webhook_url = "https://hooks.example.com/ropeshift"

[notify_policy.spend_channels]
spend_hard_limit = ["desktop", "webhook"]
spend_policy_changed = ["webhook"]
